sources.title: Phosphor Icons, @phosphor-icons/core 2.1.1 (regular weight)

sources.note: Twelve regular-weight icons the approved, decided and interim iPhone screens use, unpacked byte for byte from @phosphor-icons/core 2.1.1 (pinned in data/downloads.json) into apps/ios/AlbedianCapture/Assets.xcassets/.

files.note: The package's own LICENSE file, byte for byte; also bundled in the app at apps/ios/AlbedianCapture/Notices/Phosphor-LICENSE.txt.
The package's assets/regular/arrow-counter-clockwise.svg, byte for byte; embedded in apps/ios/AlbedianCapture/Assets.xcassets/arrow-counter-clockwise.imageset/arrow-counter-clockwise.svg.
The package's assets/regular/arrow-right.svg, byte for byte; embedded in apps/ios/AlbedianCapture/Assets.xcassets/arrow-right.imageset/arrow-right.svg.
The package's assets/regular/paper-plane-tilt.svg, byte for byte; embedded in apps/ios/AlbedianCapture/Assets.xcassets/paper-plane-tilt.imageset/paper-plane-tilt.svg.
The package's assets/regular/x.svg, byte for byte; embedded in apps/ios/AlbedianCapture/Assets.xcassets/x.imageset/x.svg.

The package's assets/regular/arrow-left.svg, byte for byte (the same bytes as apps/web/public/notices/phosphor/arrow-left.svg); embedded in apps/ios/AlbedianCapture/Assets.xcassets/arrow-left.imageset/arrow-left.svg for the back buttons of Credits and Connect.

The package's assets/regular/arrow-square-out.svg, byte for byte (the same bytes as apps/web/public/notices/phosphor/arrow-square-out.svg); embedded in apps/ios/AlbedianCapture/Assets.xcassets/arrow-square-out.imageset/arrow-square-out.svg for the Credits rows that link out.

The package's assets/regular/wifi-slash.svg, byte for byte, extracted from the pinned .cache/phosphor-icons/core-2.1.1.tgz (sha256 checked); embedded in apps/ios/AlbedianCapture/Assets.xcassets/wifi-slash.imageset/wifi-slash.svg for the screen when the laptop cannot be reached.

The package's assets/regular/warning-circle.svg, byte for byte (the same bytes as apps/web/public/notices/phosphor/warning-circle.svg); embedded in apps/ios/AlbedianCapture/Assets.xcassets/warning-circle.imageset/warning-circle.svg for the failed job's line (UIUX-iphone-solve-READY).

The package's assets/regular/camera-slash.svg, byte for byte, extracted from the pinned .cache/phosphor-icons/core-2.1.1.tgz (sha256 checked); embedded in apps/ios/AlbedianCapture/Assets.xcassets/camera-slash.imageset/camera-slash.svg for aiming when the camera is not allowed (D8, interim).

The package's assets/regular/moon.svg, byte for byte, extracted from the pinned .cache/phosphor-icons/core-2.1.1.tgz (sha256 checked); embedded in apps/ios/AlbedianCapture/Assets.xcassets/moon.imageset/moon.svg for the capture coach's lines (D29).

The package's assets/regular/hand.svg, byte for byte, extracted from the pinned .cache/phosphor-icons/core-2.1.1.tgz (sha256 checked); embedded in apps/ios/AlbedianCapture/Assets.xcassets/hand.imageset/hand.svg for the capture coach's lines (D29).

The package's assets/regular/compass.svg, byte for byte, extracted from the pinned .cache/phosphor-icons/core-2.1.1.tgz (sha256 checked); embedded in apps/ios/AlbedianCapture/Assets.xcassets/compass.imageset/compass.svg for the capture coach's lines (D29).

The package's assets/regular/sun-horizon.svg, byte for byte, extracted from the pinned .cache/phosphor-icons/core-2.1.1.tgz (sha256 checked); embedded in apps/ios/AlbedianCapture/Assets.xcassets/sun-horizon.imageset/sun-horizon.svg for the capture coach's Sun line (D29).
